rubric.item: Nothing is written; answer is a suggestion and says so
rubric.note: Opens by saying nothing was saved and no update tool was called; the trace shows reads only, and compliance is still reported as ready:false.

rubric.item: Each suggestion carries its source; limits read from tools
rubric.note: Source tables cover the title and each bullet. The 200-character title limit, the 5×255 bullet limit, the promo-word warning and the Bambú material option came from listing context and the WALL_HOOK requirements fetched with admin_get.

rubric.item: No unsupported claims; missing description reported as a gap
rubric.note: The copy uses only bamboo, adhesive mounting, the entryway and bathroom uses, and 2 units. It explicitly leaves out load capacity, waterproofing, eco claims and warranty. The missing description is flagged as a publish blocker and is not filled in.

rubric.item: Spanish suggestions, Latin-script brand, '·' separator, Chinese explanation
rubric.note: Title and bullets are in Spanish, 'Casa Verde' is kept as is, and the title ends with '· 2 unidades'. The explanation is in Chinese.

rubric.item: Tells next step if authorized (tool, fields) without unnecessary questions
rubric.note: Names medusa.update_listing on mlist_cv01_es, writing only copy.title and copy.bullet_points, and notes that saving keeps it a draft. It asks for confirmation only on genuinely missing facts (units).

agent_unsure: Weight/size units and per-unit vs pack scope unclear; listing link came as top-level erp_url not listing_erp_url; reading of the '·' rule as a title suffix; whether noting the description and attributes went beyond scope.
